title: One Cocoon = 900m of Silk — China's Deadly 1,000-Year Secret | China Travel Expert
description:
How can one silkworm cocoon hold a thread almost a kilometer long?

A single cocoon unwinds into one unbroken filament up to ~900 meters, reeled together into silk thread. China guarded how it was made for over a thousand years — smuggling silkworm eggs was punishable by death, until two monks slipped eggs west in hollow canes around 550 AD. The trade it powered became the Silk Road, and sericulture joined UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list in 2009.

🧭 Expert Tip: Buying silk in China? Burn one loose thread — real silk smells like burnt hair, self-extinguishes and crushes to fine ash; fake silk melts into a hard plastic bead with a chemical smell.
